largeheadline_copy.line1: Hydro irrigation system

Hydro irrigation system is your partner in ENT and neuro procedures. It simplifies sinuscope cleaning, restoring clarity with just a tap. It is designed to reduce delays from start to finish.1 It’s visualization, enhanced.

largeheadline.line1: Confidence begins with a clear view
largeheadline.line2: In the OR, every second of clarity counts. Inefficiencies like complex setups, unresponsive systems or repeated steps can impact visualization and slow momentum. That’s why Hydro irrigation system was created — to remove the obstacles between you and a clear view. With simple setup, intuitive interface and responsive visualization that restores clarity in seconds, Hydro irrigation system helps you focus where it matters most.1

largeheadline_1243343126.line1: See the crystal-clear difference.

largeheadline_copy.line2: Reduce delays while maintaining visualization

text_copy_copy_copy_.text: A simple tap of the foot pedal initiates cleaning, with an average lens-to-retraction irrigation time of less than 3.0 seconds.1
Pairing Hydro irrigation system with RISE provides a customized and connected surgical experience with practical upgrades, like voice activation and vivid images with the 1788 platform.

largeheadline_copy_c.line1: When space is tight

text_copy_copy_copy.text: Stryker’s 3.1 mm and 4.0 mm Precision 4K Sinuscopes are available with multiple viewing angles and working lengths to accommodate a variety of situations. Our state-of-the-art reusable Precision S HydroFlow Sheaths adds less than 1 mm to the scope diameter, preserving working space.3

largeheadline_copy_c.line2: A difference you can see

text_copy_copy_copy_.text: Hydro irrigation system’s cleaning performance is effective, often just a single cycle is required to restore image clarity.1 An electropolished distal tip helps reduce water beading and light reflection for clearer views.3

text_copy_copy.text:
A universal luer lock lets you work with compatible, existing OR systems.* That means you can choose from a broad selection of scopes of various makes and models and be assured of a proper fit.

*Refer to IFU for scope compatibility

largeheadline_copy.line2: A friendly addition to your OR

text_copy_copy_copy.text: The irrigation cassette’s one-click connection makes setup effortless.1 Designed with a minimal footprint, the Hydro irrigation console adapts seamlessly to your OR. Flexible mounting options—on a pole, cart, or boom—give you the freedom to set up your space the way that works best for you.

largeheadline_copy.line2: Designed for ease of use

text_copy_copy_copy.text: An intuitive interface allows you to quickly navigate the system’s functions and master its capabilities.

largeheadline_copy.line1: Cost effective and sustainable
largeheadline_copy.line2: Save money and the planet with each use

text_copy_copy_copy.text: Components like our Precision S HydroFlow Sheath are reusable, which makes them more economical and environmentally friendly than disposable products.2

text_copy.text: Designed with ENT and neurosurgery in mind, RISE integrates existing Stryker solutions to create a connected surgical experience tailored just for you. Our advanced platform prioritizes visualization, control and integration with features like custom surgeon profiles, voice activation, a consolidated foot pedal and the 1788 camera.

text_copy_copy.text: Powered by Stryker’s CORE 2 console, the Pello microdebrider’s proprietary blades help reduce clogging and transform your surgical experience. With its balanced ergonomic design and the quality of Stryker, Pello provides reliable and efficient cutting in ENT procedures.
